public_rationale: Marcus's phrase 'has seemed to' expresses a qualified impression without a defined evidence set or standard for comparing the two views [marcus-kara-swisher-sam-altman-and-the-openai-b40825-o1]. On May 28, 2024, Helen Toner alleged that Altman had withheld information and misled the board [e1]. On March 8, 2024, OpenAI announced completion of the WilmerHale review and expressed full confidence in Altman and Brockman's continued leadership [e2]. These sources provide competing context, but neither can verify or refute Marcus's impression of every relevant item [e1; e2]. Scoring that impression as an objective claim would remove the qualification in his words [marcus-kara-swisher-sam-altman-and-the-openai-b40825-o1].
limitations: Toner's interview records her allegations but does not independently establish the underlying conduct [e1].
The captured OpenAI announcement does not state that removal was unnecessary or that concerns about candor were unfounded [e2].
These two sources do not provide a complete inventory of evidence from November 17, 2023, through May 29, 2024.
This assessment does not decide whether Altman misled the board or whether his dismissal was justified.

our_interpretation: The claim expresses a qualified impression of the evidence. Treating it as an unqualified assertion that every public finding supported Marcus would remove 'has seemed to'.
The surrounding discussion concerns whether the board had legitimate reasons to question Altman's candor. Criticism of the dismissal process does not itself undermine those concerns.
The contextual period is the November 17, 2023 board dispute through publication on May 29, 2024. The exact starting point of 'since' is unspecified.
No objective scoring rule preserves both the hedge and the unspecified standard for evidence seeming to support one view over another.
criteria.support_condition: No objective support condition is available without strengthening the claim. Corroborating testimony can explain Marcus's impression but cannot establish that every item seemed favorable to him.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No objective contradiction condition is available without removing the hedge. Contrary findings can challenge his interpretation, but do not establish that he did not hold the stated impression.
